'''Grrtok's Band''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group who operated in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was made up of over 400 expatriated [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] commanded by [[Grrtok]]. The group was contracted to [[House Barnaba]].
